problem: University students struggle to find suitable study groups
goals: Match students on course, availability, and preferred study style

user_stories.i_want: To easily find and join study groups
user_stories.so_that: I can improve my academic performance
acceptance_criteria: The app displays a list of available study groups
The app allows users to filter study groups by course, availability, and study style
The app enables users to join a study group

user_stories.i_want: To be matched with study groups that fit my preferences
user_stories.so_that: I can focus on my studies without wasting time on unsuitable groups
acceptance_criteria: The app uses a matching algorithm to pair students with suitable study groups
The app takes into account course, availability, and study style preferences

user_stories.i_want: To be able to manage study groups and user data
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure the app is used responsibly and effectively
acceptance_criteria: The app allows administrators to create and manage study groups
The app enables administrators to view and manage user data
The app is user-friendly and easy to navigate
The app is secure and protects user data
The app is scalable and can handle a large number of users

risks.description: Difficulty in developing a suitable matching algorithm
Insufficient resources to ensure the app's scalability
